newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity options 1996 volume posts record.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity options 1996 volume posts record.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume in 1996 reached an all-time high of 199,117,729 contracts, 14 percent higher than the 1995 record of 174,380,236 contracts, the Options Industry Council (OIC) said Tuesday.
December equity option volume at the five options exchanges totaled 18,424,540 contracts, up 33 percent from 13,857,160 in December 1995.
Average daily volume in December was 877,359 contracts, up 26.6 percent from 692,858 contracts in December 1995.
